evidence.mission_note: This is purely a high-end keeper/collector-tier example. Its likely price is far beyond the state budget band, so it conflicts directly with cash preservation and the accelerated_bridge need for an affordable manual daily. As a daily driver it also carries S54 rod-bearing exposure.
evidence.rationale: The listing establishes a VIN-confirmed 2002 S54 M Coupe in the desirable non-sunroof configuration with a manual gearbox and LSD. It has a clean Carfax showing 16 service records but 6 previous owners, and a traceable $77,000 BaT sale in September 2022. Dated work is described by the dealer: VANOS update, valve adjustment, DSC unit and A/C compressor in 2022; fuel pump in 2023; tires in May 2024; and oil, coolant and filters in October 2026. No invoices were examined here. Observed issues are a 2022 hood and bumper repaint without a stated cause, disclosed lower fascia scrapes, and an odometer-exempt Maine title. The two model-critical risks remain open: there is no rod-bearing record or oil analysis for this S54, and the trunk floor and differential mount ears are not shown. The car's own sale history and market position put the expected hammer well above both the comps-based fair value range and Jason's budget band. Paint is Imola Red, a colour he disfavours.
evidence.next_action: Ask the dealer for rod-bearing records or a current oil analysis, trunk-floor photos with the carpet removed, and confirmation that an independent PPI can be done before the 2026-11-07 close.
